facts.business: Explicit Finance Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in micro financing and unsecured consumer loans.
key_risks: Market risk and liquidity risk inherent to NBFC sector
Regulatory risk from periodic RBI norm changes impacting working pattern and cash flow
Secondary market volatility and unstable trends
Exposure to economy and industry cycles
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions with potential conflict of interest. Disclosures in Form AOC-2 not furnished. All transactions placed before Audit Committee and Board for approval.
